title: Host's talk with former Skunk Works head of revolutionary technology
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Host's talk with former Skunk Works head of revolutionary technology, about 2024 at Lockheed Skunk Works, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I I recently a couple weeks ago I spoke with uh had a revolutionary former head of revolutionary technology is at locked skunkworks

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2024 he spoke with a man who had been head of revolutionary technology at Skunk Works, the secretive advanced aircraft division of the company Lockheed. He mentions it in his documentary about Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks about UFOs, as a sign that people from inside the aerospace world are talking about these subjects.
